releaseTitle: ATalk v3.4.7 — One-Click Telegram Popup, Deduplicated Actions, Full Emoji Lineup, HD Photos & Dynamic Big Emojis
releaseNotes:
• One-Click Message Popup: Single tap on any message immediately opens the anchored Telegram popup card.
• Action Deduplication: Removed duplicate Copy, Forward, and Delete from popup (handled cleanly in top header during selection).
• Full Reaction Lineup: Expanded reaction strip to the full Telegram most-used emoji lineup with smooth horizontal scrolling.
• Original HD Quality Photos: Added HD toggle to send 100% uncompressed raw camera bytes with cyan HD badge on bubble.
• Dynamic Big Emojis: Single emojis render at 58sp with animated heartbeat pulse on hearts and borderless floating container.
